Birch Hill Investment Advisors Has Lifted Holding in Shire Plc (SHPG) by $2.54 Million as Stock Value Declined; Citigroup (C) Shareholder Karpas Strategies Trimmed Stake by $368,890
May 27, 2018 - By Marguerite Chambers
Birch Hill Investment Advisors Llc increased its stake in Shire Plc (SHPG) by 16.25% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Birch Hill Investment Advisors Llc bought 16,408 shares as the company’s stock declined 17.82% with the market. The institutional investor held 117,395 shares of the major pharmaceuticals company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $18.21M, up from 100,987 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Birch Hill Investment Advisors Llc who had been investing in Shire Plc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $50.66 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.44% or $0.73 during the last trading session, reaching $165.23. About 874,878 shares traded. Shire plc (NASDAQ:SHPG) has declined 27.67% since May 27, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 39.22% the S&P500.
Karpas Strategies Llc decreased its stake in Citigroup Inc (C) by 11.66% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Karpas Strategies Llc sold 4,985 shares as the company’s stock declined 9.55% with the market. The institutional investor held 37,773 shares of the major banks company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.81M, down from 42,758 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Karpas Strategies Llc who had been investing in Citigroup Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $174.52 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.26% or $0.87 during the last trading session, reaching $68.44. About 16.01 million shares traded. Citigroup Inc. (NYSE:C) has risen 17.06% since May 27, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 5.51% the S&P500.
